locators.identity: S1 Comment and S2 Experimental: natural Mitsukoshi, Hizen-cho, Karatsu, Saga, Japan; source-reported specimen RRUFF R060993, not independently resolved as an external mineral identifier.
locators.chemistry: S2 Experimental: CAMECA SX100,15keV,10nA,20um beam; average23points. Printed empirical Nd0.95La0.61Pr0.17Sm0.12Gd0.08Y0.04Eu0.03 sum2 carbonate with7.97water on17oxygen basis; water by difference. Minor Tb/Dy oxide values occur in the listed analyses but not the displayed empirical formula; do not silently renormalize.
locators.structure: Main Crystal data/Refinement and full supplementary tables: Pccn,296K,MoKa; a8.9391(4),b9.4694(4),c16.9374(8)angstrom,V1433.72(11)angstrom3; refined all REE as Nd, hydrogen positions excluded. Table1 oxygen separations and bond-valence reasoning inform proposed hydrogen-bond connections.
locators.figures: Figure1 sheet polyhedra; Figure2 displacement ellipsoids at99% probability; Figure3 specimen photograph. These are the original source figures, not redrawn validation evidence.

primary_sources.limitations: Mixed natural chemistry is not a pure end-member or ore grade. H2O is not an independently measured water assay. Similar X-ray scattering prevents separate site-specific REE assignment. No controlled microbial or recovery assay.

deferred_primary_source.citation: Vallina B et al. 2015. The role of amorphous precursors in the crystallization of La and Nd carbonates. Nanoscale7:12166-12179.
deferred_primary_source.role: Primary abiotic carbonate formation/transformation experiment, not microbial evidence
deferred_primary_source.access: Complete14-page published version acquired from author institution White Rose repository; all pages, Tables1-3 and Figures1-10 visually inspected. Publisher landing/text routes403; one inferred conventional supplement URL404. Relevant original SI FigureSI-1 indexing and FigureSI-3 Nd spectra remain unacquired.
deferred_primary_source.conditions: p12167: synthetic10mM Nd(NO3)3·6H2O solution mixed with10mM Na2CO3 solution under stirring21C; mixing volumes and final concentrations not specified in inspected main text. Wet aging in native solution regularly shaken; at least3 and at most6 repeated experiments. Separate dry-ambient, dry-heated and hydrothermal arms must not be pooled.
deferred_primary_source.source_claims: Table2,p12171 assigns amorphous Nd precursor at21C4h, lanthanite-(Nd)24h and mixed tengerite/lanthanite at1440h. SEM and powder diffraction identify phases; percentages are phase abundances, not recovered Nd yields. Dry-ambient Nd precursor remained amorphous to6months. At60C the stated sequence bypasses lanthanite and reaches tengerite by14h.
conflicts: Table2 assigns amorphous material at21C4h but morphology text p12173 assigns lanthanite plates to21C4h.
Figure6b p12172 labels the mixed tengerite/lanthanite trace21C24h and the lower lanthanite trace21C60d, opposite Table2 and accompanying narrative; label reversal is plausible but unverified.
Table2 dry-heated Nd dioxycarbonate is called hexagonal, results p12169 call it monoclinic, discussion p12175 calls it cubic. This separate thermal arm is not curated.
Figure10 prints90C where experimental methods/table use95C; no silent equivalence assumed.
Figure3 caption points to SI-1 for IR assignments whereas main text points to SI-2; original SI needed.
deferred_primary_source.decision: Defer mechanism field in this batch. Acquire original SI and reconcile timing/sample-label provenance before selecting bounded transformation evidence. Keep observed phase presence separate from exact timing, proposed dissolution-reprecipitation, measured product purity and recovery.
deferred_primary_source.notice_check: Exact DOI correction/corrigendum/retraction query plus Crossref metadata showed no affecting notice in bounded results. No comprehensive publisher correction absence claim.
deferred_primary_source.rights: White Rose identifies published version under CC BY-NC3.0; raw paper remains outside Git.
deferred_primary_source.schema_handoff: If resolved, add narrowly scoped process other,microbial false evidence to lanthanite-nd, with source conflicts and negative arms explicit; laboratory synthesis is not industrial or microbial recovery. No quantitative concentration observations from phase percentages.
